response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_difference FROM budget WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS value FROM status_averages) SELECT s.event_status, s.average_difference, s.average_difference - b.value AS difference_from_baseline FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL
